components.name: Primary button
components.description: Ivory primary action with dark text.
components.css: .ds-primary{font:14px/1.5 var(--font);cursor:pointer;transition:color 160ms var(--ease),background-color 160ms var(--ease),border-color 160ms var(--ease);padding:9px 16px;min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--ink)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font:14px/1.5 var(--font);cursor:pointer;transition:color 160ms var(--ease),background-color 160ms var(--ease),border-color 160ms var(--ease);padding:9px 16px;min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:var(--ink)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Composer

narrative.overview:
Obsidian is a quiet working room: neutral near-black layers, warm ivory text, subtle boundaries and useful space. The existing agent workspace stays operational; hierarchy comes from type, spacing and surface tone.

The composer leads the starting surface. Navigation stays integrated into the edge, and actual task state supplies the detail. This records the approved visual refinement of the existing app; audience and positioning are unspecified.
keyCharacteristics: Readable secondary text and restrained metadata.
Intrinsic message heights with separate transcript and composer areas.
State-driven orb motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Neutral Action Rule
rules.body: Use ivory for primary actions and focus. Reserve subdued semantic colours for labelled status and data, never capability decoration.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Use surface tone and fine borders for everyday depth; reserve shadows for overlays.

dos: Do reuse the shared tokens across chat, tasks, history, settings and live tools.
Do keep ordinary prose wrapping and code or tables scrolling within their own containers.
Do keep the transcript keyboard-focusable and bounded above the separate composer dock.
Do preserve real task state, orb lifecycle and both reduced-motion mechanisms.
donts: Don't restore coloured capability tiles, glows or decorative gradients to the neutral controls.
Don't stretch messages or thinking rows to fill spare pane height.
Don't render the decorative globe on active conversation or live routes, or put the fallback beneath a loaded globe.
Don't invent progress, agent reasoning or production content.
